- Platform readings this shift: the auto-mode classifier refuses, as `[Self-Modification]`, the seat's own relay stroke that flips/enqueues a PR changing `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, and refused (no reason) the dev's Edit on the same file — a Tier S landing on that file is a human's until a settings rule says otherwise; `check-expected-skips.mjs` needs `yaml`, absent from the shared checkout's empty `node_modules` — a copy at `/home/user/node_modules/yaml` (outside every checkout) resolves for the ESM lookup; `post-stamped` refuses a bare stamp beside `{{NOW}}` anywhere in the body (quote readings as `{{WAS:…}}`) and a `Thread-read:` value with anything after the id; parallel Bash calls in one turn share the shell's working directory — use `git -C` and absolute paths; a zero reading needs a positive control on the same instrument (the `skills/**` grep that answered 0 this morning answered 2 when re-run); `[.[].id]|last` over one 100-comment page is not the newest comment on a long thread — read with `since=`.
- Timers and subscriptions: patrol Routine `trig_01EX1gU7pjEcXx3RuiZ4wAsS` (cron `2 * * * *`); flip pointers (`send_later`) for PR #22995 and PR #23002; `subscribe_pr_activity` on PR #22982, PR #22995, PR #22997, PR #23002 and objectui PR #12210.
